### B04/B07/B08 — exact scalar bulk-to-boundary carrier

- Solved the Euclidean massive scalar equation on an interval with independent endpoint values.

  X_{m,L}=\frac{m}{\sinh(mL)}

  \[
  \begin{pmatrix}5/4&-3/4\\-3/4&5/4\end{pmatrix}
  \]

- Glued two intervals by eliminating their common boundary value and verified that the Schur complement is exactly the doubled-interval response.
- Identified the equivalent determinant-one transfer matrix, completing the bulk action \(\to\) boundary Hessian \(\to\) Jordan cone \(\to\) symplectic composition chain in this model.
- Recorded the massless zero mode: the cone becomes positive semidefinite unless that mode is removed or controlled.

### B03 — canonical real structure on the conjugate pair

- Imposed the model anti-linear involution \(\kappa(v,w)=(\bar w,\bar v)\).
- Solved its neutral multiplicity-two compatibility condition as

  \begin{pmatrix}a&b\\\bar b&\bar a\end{pmatrix}.

- Found real commutant dimension four in the neutral block and two for each charged conjugate pair, giving total real dimension ten.
- Found six real Hermitian coupling parameters: three neutral and one for each of three charged pairs.
- Preserved the decisive qualification: this is a canonical swap-conjugation model, not yet a verified transcription of Furey’s exact involution matrices.
